description: DALL-E 2 is OpenAI's previous generation image generation model. It can create and edit images from text descriptions, with support for inpainting and outpainting. Superseded by DALL-E 3 for most use cases.

outOfScope: Generating violent, adult, or hateful content

trainingData.description: Trained on a large dataset of images and text. Specific training data composition is proprietary.

trainingProcedure: Uses diffusion model architecture. Specific methodology is proprietary.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Was state-of-the-art at release. Now superseded by DALL-E 3 which offers better prompt following, image quality, and safety features.

knownLimitations: Weaker prompt adherence compared to DALL-E 3
Cannot generate images of real public figures
Consider using DALL-E 3 for new applications

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: May reflect biases in training data. OpenAI has implemented some mitigations.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Content policy enforcement, restrictions on harmful content generation.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Generated images may be stored by OpenAI. Check terms for usage rights.
